items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: And I was playing the violin. The air crumb was playing. And we ended up, just about three of us, playing the rest of the band.

ctx.x: Well, what about the, uh, Paché Club? I wanted to...

This is one of our early deals at what we called a quartier club in that days. And it was a script dance of some sorts. I don't know who gave it. But I remember one poor guy was dressed up as a, what would you call it? He just had a loin cloth on and some kind of skin over his shoulder and it was cold as hell. And we found him and passed out in the back of the yard. How the hell did he get pneumonia? I don't know, maybe he did, but we never heard from him further. We got him in there.
